name: Northern Star (Ioun Stone)
body:
Price 10,000 gp; Slot none; CL 12th; Weight —; Aura strong transmutation

DESCRIPTION

This pearlescent crystal is perfectly cut in the shape of a five-pointed star.

EFFECTS

It grants the bearer a +5 competence bonus on Acrobatics and Climb checks. When inserted into a wayfinder, it grants the bearer a +4 bonus on Reflex saves to avoid falling.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 5,000 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells jump; Special creator must be at least 12th level
